title: Card
description: One hand card. Every action discards exactly one. Other seats' cards are replaced by hidden placeholders before broadcast.

id.description: Content-derived id: loc-<city>-<i>, ind-<industry>-<n>, ind-cm-<i>, or wl-/wi-<next-tile-id>-<player-id>. Redacted opponent cards use hidden-<player-id>-<index>.

type.description: Card face. Wilds are minted only by Scout and returned to a shared pool when discarded.

city.description: Board-location id, on a location card. Absent on every other face, and absent on a redacted placeholder even though its type is "location".

industries.description: Allowed industries on an industry card. Two entries only for the dual cotton/manufacturer face.

face-down.description: Seeded into the canal-era discard pile face down, so it is attributed to no played action. Cleared when the era transition reshuffles.
